Make helmet, visor eyes and plume immediately legible when the icon is displayed at 32 pixels high. Calm confident guardian personality. No face reveal, no baby/chibi proportions, no new costume or helmet, no broom or large shield, no full body, no arms/hands, no tiny engravings, noisy texture, dithering, gradients or soft painting. This is one polished static square game HUD/pause/result icon on a truly transparent background, without scenery, decorative frame, text, letters or magic particles.
